strengths: Title and intro match the query “why Japanese people give gifts so often” and immediately qualify “so often” as situation clusters, which is the honest intent match.
Omiyage, temiyage, ochugen, oseibo, okaeshi appear in natural prose, not stuffed lists.
FAQ covers the real follow-ups: every meetup?, what to bring, why food, are seasonal gifts required, refusing, expensive thanks.
Packaging and tipping asides are short and linked—on-intent, not a detour into wrapping design or restaurant tips.

issues.problem: A high-intent related query—omiyage vs temiyage—is answered in H2 but not as a FAQ heading searchers often use.
issues.suggestion: Optional FAQ: souvenir for the group vs bag when you visit a home. Do not keyword-stuff the H2s.
